subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar, em notícias, o fato central, suas principais circunstâncias e eventuais decorrências; em reportagens e fotorreportagens o fato ou a temática retratada e a perspectiva de abordagem, em entrevistas os principais temas/subtemas abordados, explicações dadas ou teses defendidas em relação a esses subtemas; em tirinhas, memes, charge, a crítica, ironia ou humor presente.

components.description_pt: Identificar evento central e suas principais circunstâncias e consequências em notícia
components.description_en: Identify the central event and its main circumstances and consequences in a news article
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main idea of an informational text and its relationship to supporting ideas

components.description_pt: Identificar tema e ângulo de abordagem em reportagem ou fotodenuncia
components.description_en: Identify the theme and angle of approach in a report or photo-essay
components.cc_component_description: Identify a theme or central idea in a literary text

components.description_pt: Identificar temas e teses principais abordados em entrevista
components.description_en: Identify the main topics and theses addressed in an interview
components.cc_component_description: Determine the main idea of an informational text

components.description_pt: Identificar crítica, ironia ou humor expressos em histórias em quadrinhos, memes ou charges
components.description_en: Identify the critique, irony, or humor conveyed in comic strips, memes, or editorial cartoons
components.cc_component_description: Interpret the meaning of figurative language in context, including irony and paradox

cc_matches.description: Determine a theme or central idea of a text and analyze its development over the course of the text; provide an objective summary of the text.
Determine the main idea of a text; recount the key details and explain how they support the main idea.
Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings.

Multilingual learners will interpret informational texts in language arts by
* Identifying and/or summarizing main ideas __and their relationship to supporting ideas__
* Analyzing __observations and descriptions in textual evidence for key attributes, qualities, characteristics, activities, and behaviors__
* Evaluating the impact of __author’s__ key word choices __over the course of a text__
